[[File:SW-CloneWarsAdventuresVol10-EarlyCoverArt.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker use a VXL speeder to elude bounty hunters.]]
'''VXL speeders''' were large speeders that were manufactured in the time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were considered classics by mechanics&mdash;such as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;and nostalgics&mdash;such as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]&mdash;alike. However, by those uninterested in speeders, they were considered "pieces of junk," an opinion favored by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. During the Clone Wars, Anakin Skywalker was able to salvage an old VXL speeder to use as a getaway vehicle to aid Obi-Wan Kenobi and himself in escaping from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in [[Death Canyon]].<ref name="ThunderRoad">{{CWACite|10|Thunder Road}}</ref>
